verdict.rationale: ZCode's marketing says its Goal feature keeps planning, executing and verifying multi-step work (zcode-docs-2). It also says tasks can be triggered remotely via WeChat, Feishu or Telegram so they start executing without the user at the desk (zcode-docs-3). The CLI can run a headless web server with `--no-open` (zcode-gh-3). Together these suggest agentic, remotely kicked-off execution, but nothing documents user-configured automations that run unattended in the background. missing for 10: scheduled/cron or event-triggered automation setup, documentation of background or unattended execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration that Goal or remote tasks run autonomously.
